text: Before the real orders, let’s try one practice order together. Nothing counts yet.
Chef 1, you’re Prep. Tap the chopping board until every dot is filled.
Chef 2, you’re Cook. Tap an empty burner to start cooking.
Watch the ring fill up. That’s the food cooking.
It’s ready! Chef 2, tap the food. In the real rush, food left too long burns.
Chef 3, you’re Pack. Tap each food into the box, then tap Seal and label.
Chef 4, you’re Dispatch. Tap Send to give the box to a rider.
Far side is slow tonight. Twenty-four minutes each way.
First tries are for learning. Let’s look at what really happened.
Your first box met real orders.
There is no one right answer. Pick a plan you can explain.
Ninety minutes to midnight. Same jobs, new plan, new bar. Let’s see how it works.
Good enough changed tonight because the night changed. Where else is that true?
Hmm. Would your best look the same for a sandcastle at the beach and a real house?
By your own bar, how did the night go?. Pass = it reached your bar. Fail = it didn’t.
Thanks, team. Everyone got home safe. Some boxes were late, and you told people the truth.
Our name was on every box tonight. You decided what that meant.
You know these customers. You decide.
Thanks, team. Safe, and before midnight.

Hi! I’m Meher Didi. This is my kitchen.
Tonight, families order party boxes until midnight.
If a box is late or cold, a party has no food.
Which station is yours tonight?. Each of you runs one part.
Tonight, you decide what “good enough” means.
Let’s make a party box for tonight.
Pick any 3 foods. Real orders will show us how they travel.
Pick 3 foods for the party box. A first try. There are no wrong answers.
How will the food travel?. Pick one box for every order.
Tonight, your team sets the bar.
A bar is like a high jump. It’s the line you try to get over.
First, read what our customers say.
Messages from tonight’s customers. These messages are your clues.
What does “good enough” mean tonight?. There is no right answer.
Rewrite tonight’s bar. There is no right answer.
Does our bar still fit tonight?. Fewer riders means slower trips. Your bar can change too.
Here come the real orders! Look after your station, and watch the others too.
That’s the whole trip: Prep, Cook, Pack, Dispatch.
The bar under each station shows how many orders are waiting.
If a station glows gold, it needs help. Anyone can tap HELP to jump in.
Why do you think they failed?.
Every line passed. Why?. Was the kitchen great, or was the bar too low?
Change one thing for Shift 2. Think about what happened tonight.
Which clue made you choose it?. A clue is something that really happened.
Which station gets a helper?. The helper stays for all of Shift 2.
Take one out, put one in.
Boxes are piling up at the door!. Only Chef 4 can see the rider card. Everyone else, ask them!
How many riders are free now?. Everyone except Chef 4 answers.
Anya’s family wrote back. The night has changed. Does your bar still fit?
Pick one or two changes. Six riders. Eight boxes waiting.
When will food arrive?. Agree as a team. Both messages will use it.
Now tell families. They’re getting ready for a party.
Now tell riders. They’re on a scooter, about to leave.

For a 5-year-old’s birthday party, good enough means…
For judges at a baking contest, good enough means…
For a teacher, due tomorrow, good enough means…
For visitors at the science fair, good enough means…
For you, at the beach today, good enough means…
For a family who will live there for years, good enough means…
Good enough isn’t perfect. It’s what people need, right now.
Who is it for? What do they need?
